When men propose, the algorithm proceeds as follows:
1. m1 proposes to wn (his first choice) and is accepted.
2. m2 proposes to wn and is rejected (since wn prefers m1), then proposes
3. m3 proposes to wn (rejected), then wn−1 (rejected by m2), then wn−2
5. mk makes k proposals: rejected by wn, wn−1, . . . , wn−k+2, then accepted
